title: Units in a face localization
statement: Let $Q$ be a commutative monoid, written additively, which is integral (its canonical map to its group completion $Q^{\rm gp}$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] is injective), and let $F\subseteq Q$ be a face, meaning a submonoid such that $a+b\in F$ with $a,b\in Q$ implies $a,b\in F$. For $Q_F=\{q-f:q\in Q,\ f\in F\}\subseteq Q^{\rm gp}$, the group of units of $Q_F$ is exactly the subgroup $F^{\rm gp}\subseteq Q^{\rm gp}$ generated by $F$.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.1--3.1.2, printed pp. 98--99; characterization of the units after localization at a face.

proof.text: For each f in F, the element f=f-0 belongs to Q_F and has inverse 0-f, which also belongs to Q_F. Units form a subgroup, so every difference f_1-f_2 and hence every element of the subgroup F^{\rm gp} generated by F is a unit of Q_F.

Conversely, let x be a unit of Q_F. Write x=q-f and its inverse as y=q'-f' with q,q'\in Q and f,f'\in F. The equality x+y=0 in Q^{\rm gp} gives q+q'=f+f' in Q^{\rm gp}; integrality of Q makes the canonical map Q\to Q^{\rm gp} injective, so this is an equality in Q. Since f+f' lies in the face F, the face condition implies q,q'\in F. Therefore x=q-f lies in F^{\rm gp}. Thus the units of Q_F are exactly F^{\rm gp}.

proof_origin.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.1--3.1.2, printed p. 98: only the definitions of M^\times, sharpening and M_S=M[S^{-1}]\subseteq M^{\rm gp} for integral M are taken from there; the units characterization and its proof are written by an agent.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q121-59c6b950f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full, its stmt_dep def-trf-fs-log-blowup (which defines P^gp and integrality), the citer lem-trf-fs-face-sharpening, the siblings lem-trf-face-localization-fs, lem-trf-face-subgroup-saturated, lem-trf-log-regular-sharp-chart and lem-trf-log-regular-monoidal-ideal-contraction, the unit sk-i-curve-zero, and ILO Exposé VIII 3.1.1-3.1.2 (printed p.98, through pdftotext). The statement matches 3.1.2, where for integral M the localization is M_S=M[S^{-1}] inside M^gp; integrality is a hypothesis of the item. Step 1 is correct: f=f-0 and -f=0-f both lie in Q_F, so F^gp is contained in the units. Step 2 is correct: from q+q'=f+f' in Q^gp, integrality gives equality in Q, and the face property applied to f+f' in F gives q,q' in F, so x is in F^gp. Both steps are genuinely elementary and proof_deps=[] is right. Small cases checked: N with {0}, N with N, N^2 with a coordinate face, and Q^x in any integral Q. The citer's fs hypothesis implies integrality. The item is a strict sub-fact of the citer, not a restatement. rg searches of the DAG and of both blueprint snapshots found no duplicate, so same_as=[] is right. There are no new nodes, no tool_uses and no SGA source; this is not a target node, so the base-change and coefficient checks do not apply. lean.statement: theorem isAddUnit_addLocalization_iff_face {Q : Type u} [AddCommMonoid Q] (hQ : Function.Injective (fun q : Q => AddLocalization.mk q (⟨0, AddSubmonoid.mem_top 0⟩ : (⊤ : AddSubmonoid Q)))) (F : AddSubmonoid Q) (hF : ∀ a b : Q, a + b ∈ F → a ∈ F ∧ b ∈ F) (x : AddLocalization F) : IsAddUnit x ↔ ∃ f₁ f₂ : F, x = AddLocalization.mk (f₁ : Q) f₂
